name: taronic
description: Minimal SVG card editor for drawing tarot deck art — icons in, SVG out.

scripts.icons:game-icons: rm -rf .game-icons-src && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/game-icons/icons .game-icons-src && rm -rf .game-icons-src/.git && node scripts/build-icons.mjs .game-icons-src game-icons src/icons/generated/game-icons.ts && rm -rf .game-icons-src
